prompt: Create ONE individual complete-character 2D fighting-game sprite, polished cel shading with crisp dark contours, coherent with Digital Circus Encore. One original static game adaptation; do not copy the product scene or its squat toy proportions. Reference 1 is the APPROVED SELECTION SEED: strictly preserve its identity, proportions, colors, exact anatomy and polished 2D style. Reference 2 supplies the official product details only. Make a genuinely different pose, never a mirrored or cropped copy of selection. DESIGN LOCK: ONE entire Ringmaster Caine wearing his BLACK outfit from the official Side Show product: RED denture head with white teeth and exactly two protruding round eyes with BLUE and GREEN irises, BLACK TOP HAT with RED band, BLACK GLITTER-FABRIC TUXEDO/TAILCOAT with thin pale trim, WHITE SHIRT FRONT with BLACK BUTTONS, small RED BOW TIE, WHITE GLOVES, BLACK TROUSERS and BLACK SHOES. POSE: STANCE facing screen RIGHT: alert balanced fighting guard, knees slightly bent and both shoes planted apart, one hand holds the cane diagonally near the torso, other white glove raised as guard. Entire top hat and cane visible.

observations: Balanced screen-right guard with bent knees, one open glove raised and one cane carried diagonally across the torso.
Black glitter tailcoat, pale piping, red bow tie, blue/green eyes, entire hat, two hands and both shoes match accepted design.
